name: UFine6926-MG / MG-Eval
description: Text-based person retrieval faces a critical but under-explored challenge: the inherent uncertainty of query granularity in real-world scenarios. This paper introduces a new paradigm, Text-based Person Retrieval with Any Granularity, and provides a systematic solution. First, we formalize a five-level granularity spectrum and construct UFine6926-MG, a high-quality multi-grained dataset annotated comprehensively at all granularities via a novel Multi-grained Text Annotation Engine.
